items.title: Web App or Desktop App: The Real Trade-offs
items.notes: Offline access, data locality, update cadence, integrations, and the failure modes of each. No product endorsements.

items.title: Designing an Automation That Fails Safely
items.notes: Idempotency, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, alerting, and a kill switch. Include a failure checklist.

items.title: How to Read an AI Model Release Note
items.notes: Separate what shipped from what was announced, check the date and the model name, and find the limits section. Use a real, current release note as the worked example.

items.title: Chatbot vs Search Engine for Research
items.notes: Where a chatbot saves time, where it invents, and the hybrid workflow that beats both. Test criteria stated up front.

items.title: AI Tool Free Tiers: What the Limits Actually Mean
items.notes: Translate vague 'limited' claims into concrete caps where the vendor documents them. Where they do not, say so plainly.

items.title: Writing Prompts That Survive a Model Upgrade
items.notes: Why brittle prompts break, what to pin (constraints, format, examples), and how to test a prompt against two models.
